meta_description: Briggs Towing serving Gastonia - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Towing in Gastonia that shows up when you call.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
cta_h2: Call us and we will come to you
quote_h2: Tell us what the vehicle is doing
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers motorcycle transport, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Gastonia and the towns around it.
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Motorcycle transport
services.body: Bikes go on the deck with soft ties and a wheel chock so nothing is clamped to a frame or a fork that was never meant to take it.
services.alt: Flatbed tow truck hauling a black SUV through a parking lot under blue sky
services.evidence: Flatbed tow truck hauling a black SUV with a motorcycle also loaded on wet pavement

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.alt: Nighttime Briggs Towing truck hauling a white cargo van
services.evidence: Flatbed tow truck hauling a wrecked car across a gravel lot

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.alt: White heavy tow truck hauling a white pickup truck
services.evidence: Empty flatbed tow truck bed parked near a storage shed

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.evidence: Black tow truck with lights on parked at night

reviews.author: Bryan Lewis
reviews.text: We called Briggs Towing at 4 AM and they answered right away and got to us quickly. Great service and very professional. Definitely recommend if you ever need a tow!

reviews.author: Pegi Campbell
reviews.text: My granddaughter had a blow out due to hitting a curb and it crushed rim. The donut was crap when we put it on and we needed the car towed. She called Briggs and they came right out. Chad had the car loaded and at our house in good time and also gave us a great lead on some new tires. We'll definitely recommend and use them in the future.

reviews.author: Kellie Garnett
reviews.text: Nothing good to say about this place at all. I was looking for a vehicle that got towed away cause it broke down in a church parking lot. The church gave me this places information so I called the place and the man was really rude. Cursed me out. Definitely not how you run a business. I understand the church made an innocent mistake and gave me the wrong place but no reason for someone to be so rude. Would definitely never give this place business. He definitely needs to learn how to talk to people.. Point blank. I been having a business for over 10 years and never raise my voice at a customer much less cursed at anyone. Disrespect at its finest!!

reviews.author: Bud Rosenberger
reviews.text: I needed my wrecked Lotus Evora towed to my shop. It is a very low, very expensive car. Chad and James were great to communicate with. Multiple phone calls to keep me posted as to “my baby’s” progress. James backed right into the shop and unloaded carefully. They really cared and made sure we were well cared for. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Shannon Cooke
reviews.text: Excellent service! Professional, reliable and at a great price. I definitely give Briggs Towing a 5 star.

reviews.author: Lori Price
reviews.text: Working with kids on Christmas eve and ran over tweezers that went in my tire. Tire was flat is seconds. Thankfully Chad from Briggs Towing was able to come to the rescue to get it switched out so I can get home to my family for Christmas eve. Thanks so much! Highly recommend

reviews.author: charlotte greene
reviews.text: It did not take Chad long to come get my car. He towed it to the mechanic and filled out the envelope and dropped the key in the dropbox so I wouldn't have to make a trip there. He also sent a pic of my car in the parking lot of the mechanic. Thank you, Chad!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Scott
reviews.text: So grateful for the quick response. My insurance roadside assistance said 105-135 mins to arrival and yall were there in 30 mins! Appreciate how professional he was and we were on our way super quick.

reviews.author: W Tines
reviews.text: Christmas Eve, we hit a deer on the way home. We called it in and our insurance called Briggs Tow. We are very happy with the service given. They kept in touch with us through the whole process and we were able to go home without waiting around. We will be using them again if the need arises.

reviews.author: Laura Jenkins
reviews.text: If yall ever need a big building moved get Briggs Towing to help! They had it moved into our yard with zero problems and perfectly leveled in about 30 minutes, and was the best price compared to actual building movers!

reviews.author: Dora Bourg
reviews.text: Guy that answered phone was disrespectful. i was calling to ask about a vehicle and he was very impatient and rude.

reviews.author: Larry Nations
reviews.text: Got picked up off 85 today lost a wheel. Briggs was fast friendly and affordable will definitely use again for my towing needs.

reviews.author: Julia Baylor
reviews.text: I cannot stress enough how great they are! Most definitely the most affordable tow I've ever had and super friendly and helpful people. I took a stack of cards to hand out to friends and family. Most definitely recommend. I won't call anyone else now.

reviews.author: Juanita Meeks
reviews.text: I called to hire this company to tow my truck. When I made a comment about his location, he was very rude to me. With his attitude I felt the best thing for me was not to work with him. This man was the rudest towing person that I've encountered.

reviews.author: Kate Funk
reviews.text: We were stranded with a trailer full of horses and a dead truck on a Sunday morning. Chad from Briggs Towing answered the phone on my first call and was out there helping us very quickly. He was kind and professional. He got our truck running and we made it home safely thanks to him.

reviews.author: Melissa Wright
reviews.text: We needed my husband's work can towed to the garage for some repairs. He graciously came promptly the next morning and took it for us. Great care of the vehicle, reasonably priced and prompt! Couldn't have asked for a better transaction! Thanks so much! Will definitely be using this company again!

reviews.author: chelsea Wright
reviews.text: Highly recommend. This company knows what they're doing and they know how to do it! I couldn't be more pleased with the assistance I received yesterday. They showed up quickly with a smile! He got my car to start and save me from getting my car towed to a shop.

reviews.author: Ryan Cartin
reviews.text: Great guy, came out at 2:00 a.m. when several other "24 hour" tow services wouldn't and AAA had us waiting for over three hours. He even explained to me how to change my alternator so I could save money on a mechanic.

reviews.author: Robbie White
reviews.text: Highly recommend. Great customer service and very professional. I called 4 different towing companies and no one answered my call. Briggs Towing answered right away and gladly help out with towing my vehicle. Every bit of the experience was flawless and exceeded all expectations. Briggs Towing will be my go to for all my towing needs.

reviews.author: tay
reviews.text: 10/10 definitely recommend! I locked my keys in the trunk by accident and didn't have my spare. Quick and easy and I was in and out in no time and retrieved my keys! If you needing any kind of help definitely recommend going to Briggs towing!

reviews.author: Abdul Kabir
reviews.text: Briggs Towing has truly earned a five-star we me. He was extremely professional patients. Before charging me to tow my vehicle to my house He tried everything within his power to fix my flat in order to save me money. It was later and cold. Briggs towing is AWESOME!!!!!!

reviews.author: Steven Maggese
reviews.text: This was my first time needing help in Gastonia, He was very nice and took good care of me. I definitely recommend this company.

reviews.author: Erin Low
reviews.text: Briggs was very fast, dependable and professional when towing our car. They took it to the mechanic, took pictures of the car after being delivered and made sure I knew it was where it needed to be. I would definitely recommend using Briggs for any of your towing needs.

reviews.author: Samantha Smith
reviews.text: I called Briggs Towing to change my tire after running over a nail in the parking lot. Briggs came very quickly as stated per our phone conversation. He was very courteous and even put air in my spare tire once he got it on. Thank you.

reviews.author: Lashan
reviews.text: After being stranded for an hour, Briggs Towing came to my rescue. They are very friendly people. They saved me a lot of money on towing and instead helped me charge my battery. That is very hard to find in companies that are only out for money, so I thank you again and will definitely be using them for my emergency car situations!!

reviews.author: Dawn
reviews.text: Briggs towing was very responsive and got to my location quickly today. Not only was he familiar with the modern technology of these newer vehicles he was careful with my nice Jeep. I asked him to tow it to a dealership after which I found out did not have a good rating and I was not comfortable with my Jeep being there. So few hours later i called him again. I ended up having him pick it back up at the drop off location and he hauled it from Gastonia all the way to Morganton. No hesitation from him knowing that was a good distance requested by me late in the day. And he seemed more than happy to do it. I do recommend Briggs towing.

reviews.author: Davis Wood
reviews.text: Fast, friendly and professional service. Got to me quickly and made my bad day a lot better. Cannot recommend enough if you are needing a tow this is the company you need. Great people and great service.

reviews.author: Sarah Stegall
reviews.text: It was a cold, rainy night before Easter and every other company I called refused to come help me. I was stranded at a sketchy gas station 30 miles from home with a giant bolt in my tire and almost in tears. Finally I called Briggs Towing and he arrived in 20 minutes, quickly put my spare on, charged me a very reasonable fee and I was on my way home to my kids. Highly recommend!!! I honestly don’t know what I would have done without him.

reviews.author: Sinni Ballamore
reviews.text: I'm a few days late with this review but had to share my experience with Briggs towing for the exceptional service. Starting with the dispatcher to the driver everyone was professional to the T! Had my starter go bad at the most random time and place at 3a.m.contacted Brigg's after a few others and was glad I did,was told that I would have help within 15 minutes and true to their word they were there.iwas home within 15 after pardon my memory of the driver's name but good guy. Even pointed me in the direction for a good price on a starter.long review I know but with good service it all involved should be acknowledged.thank you Brigg's for your service and if everme or anyone I know needs a tow I will definitely recommend you all.

reviews.author: Lisa Butler
reviews.text: I am so grateful for Briggs towing! I locked my keys in my car and had my three kids with me including my newborn and he got to me incredibly quickly and got me back in my car. He was so kind and such a lifesaver and provided help at a very reasonable price. I highly recommend Briggs and will be remembering them for any future needs!

reviews.author: Heather Bryson
reviews.text: Mr. Briggs helped us with my sons truck last minute notice on a Saturday. He was very professional and gave us a very good price. I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Isaiah Harvey
reviews.text: Briggs towing is a ten out of ten for me! I was quoted over $250 from every other company for a 20 minute tow. Briggs got it done for only 100, in less than an hour and he even gave me a drive home because I so happened to be on the way. Point is he's a really good guy. He has reasonable prices and I'm calling him anytime I need a tow from now on

reviews.author: Charlene Watson
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience.. - Our Driver walked us through every step of the process. - He was very friendly. - the price was exactly what I could afford and not A flipping arm and leg like the first 3 we called.. - & the timing was awesome, He told us 1 hour and was here in 45 minutes! - I recommend BRIGGS to any and everyone.. I appreciate the help today guys.. I'll definitely be calling you if ever needed!

reviews.author: Tracy Carroll
reviews.text: I needed a jump start and I called Briggs Towing to see how much they would charge to do a jump start. He told me how much it was going to be and I asked him how long would it take for him to get to there and he said 15 minutes. He was there in the time that he said he would be there's. I would recommend Briggs Towing to anyone. They are affordable and time efficient.

reviews.author: LaQuitta Wallace
reviews.text: Briggs towing really helped us out. My car wouldn’t start and we relocated and needy speedy service to move from old place to another location! They were very kind and helpful and got the car moved within an hour!! Definitely recommend if you need any towing services!

reviews.author: tahamara perez
reviews.text: I used Briggs tow service to transport a vehicle. Let me just tell you the driver was on time at the site very friendly and corteous. Will definitely use and recommend again. Thank you for your excellent service.

reviews.author: Flipped Platano
reviews.text: Briggs has not even arrived yet but I can already say he has gone above & beyond to help me while I am stranded on the side of the highway during a 12hr drive! 5 stars for sure! -katrina

reviews.author: Wallace Roach
reviews.text: Great pricing on tows or transport. I will use this tow company again if ever needed. Great guy and very professional. He kept in contact from initial call to drop off. I highly recommend using them.

reviews.author: Anastazija McDowell
reviews.text: Great Service: Briggs Towing if u ever need a tow service. Honest, professional and the Best Price in town. I share honest feedback as I am a consumer that rely on reviews and when service is Awesome I share if it's not I share that Too! Briggs is the Best!

reviews.author: Emily Maddox
reviews.text: Who ever picked up my car could not listen to me he was to busy forcing his tow truck on me. I felt like I was stuck with him because he literally was pretty much ready to go get my car. I told him OVER THE PHONE I was in between the shop and the house at Kingsway and he ignored me. Had 2 kids in truck so wasn't paying attention. Gave me a attitude because he wasn't listening then charged me 100$ for a 2 mile drive. He was not a nice person at all. I gave you 2 stars because him and because he did get my car home safe. Or I'd give you one. I understand when people don't give you information but I gave all the information and he still treated me like I was wrong and then gave me an attitude because he was wrong. I did what I was supposed to just because you have two kids running around and you're not paying attention that's not my problem. I'm paying you for your service. Not your attitude. Won't go through you again and won't recommend you to anyone. Should have used hornes. Have a great day thanks

reviews.author: Korey Deveaux
reviews.text: Briggs did an exceptional job getting me off the side of the highway. Response time was quick and fast. I recommend them getting your car moved.

reviews.author: Omar Smith
reviews.text: Friendly and courteous customer service. They took care of my car like it was their very own valuable possession. From this point on they will always be my first choice. Thank you Briggs Towing.

reviews.author: Rochelle Paul
reviews.text: Called him for a tow and he was very nice and willling to help. We didn’t need to use him because we were able to get the car to start and he was very understanding. I will keep this company info in case of a future issue!

reviews.author: Paul Hartz
reviews.text: I called to have my work van towed from where I broke down to a location near by. Unlike most tow companies. He was there in a flash had me hooked up and dropped off within 45 minutes! Very professional and knowledgeable about what may have happened to my vehicle after explaining to him what happened. I'll be using him again not just as a necessity but as a must in my book! Won't call another towing company again!

reviews.author: Cindy sisk
reviews.text: This place was a life saver!! Everyone else that I called told me it was going to be the next day before they could get my car but it couldn’t wait another day. The guy that towed my car came right when he said. He was professional and very nice. Very thankful for him.

reviews.author: Matthew Williams
reviews.text: Chad is professional, punctual, and reasonably priced. Got the job done for me even faster than expected. Highly recommend. Support your local small businesses!

reviews.author: Derrick Morton
reviews.text: Service was prompt and friendly. More local towing companies weren't available but he was able to help when I was trying to get to work. Really appreciate it.

reviews.author: Summer Heffner
reviews.text: Great service at a reasonable price. Easy to do business with on all levels. I would highly recommend Briggs towing anytime you need a vehicle towed or any towing service! Don’t waste your time calling other folks!

reviews.author: Carrie Mackins
reviews.text: I was at work caught 2 Juveniles trying to steal my car, it was left undrivable the Principal ask this guy wife if she would call him to tow my car they said he would be about hr. So it was on time I've other people love his work. THANK YOU MUCH

reviews.author: Kristina King
reviews.text: AMAZINGLY FAST!! Had a flat tire off the side of highway. Tire shops was closing but got me to the tire shop and was able to replace my tire before the store closed!! Life saver!

reviews.author: RahDa General
reviews.text: Best Out Here ! Good customer service and he even fixed my doors for free ! Definitely should give him a call if you in a pinch ! And the price is reasonable.

reviews.author: Cherie Copiskey
reviews.text: I would like to share my wonderful experience with your driver Mohammed. Such a wonderful person with a great personality. I truly appreciated his nice smile and engaging personality. People like Mohammed are special and hard to come by. I hope you know what a good person you have working for you. Extremely efficient and knowledgeable about AAA and even offered me some friendly advice regarding my current AAA plan. A true professional and kind person. God bless him and I wish him all the best. Cherie Copiskey

reviews.author: Khadijah watkins
reviews.text: I called the owner of this company last night. He along with his Grandfather came this morning. Awesome service and very reasonable and super nice

reviews.author: Chris Allen
reviews.text: Does a fantastic job. On time and great customer service. Takes care of your cargo. He’s a all around professional! Give him a call for your hauling needs. Thanks Chris Allen.

reviews.author: reginald Butler
reviews.text: Fast and reliable service. Needed a tow from home to repair shop. Arrived in less than 30 min. Affordable rates and very courteous.

reviews.author: marcia woolfolk
reviews.text: He came to my home to check the problem before towing. So friendly and courteous.. highly recommend Briggs Towing

reviews.author: Tonda Benton
reviews.text: These guys were so awesome. Made sure I was safe until my ride returned! Hope I don't need another tow, but if I do they will get be the first call!!

reviews.author: Nelson Rodriguez
reviews.text: Awesome customer service. Very honest and helpful . Quote for tow was cheapest I've found around. Thanks

reviews.author: Daryl Walker
reviews.text: Chad was friendly and very helpful! He even charged the battery and started the car for us... and it didn't cost an arm or leg!

reviews.author: Sherry Medlin
reviews.text: Called for a tow and a good looking man came to assist me. Very professional, polite and fast at his job! Will use again in the future.

reviews.author: MR S
reviews.text: Very honest business and the owner was very professional to speak with. The pricing for towing long distance was great, would definitely use them for future towing needs!

reviews.author: Chelsea Williams
reviews.text: Called him at 9pm in the rain, he told me the price and time and was there right when he said he was going to be. Very nice and respectful.

reviews.author: Daniel Davis
reviews.text: Quick service, very helpful. Answered all my questions and phone calls. Can’t beat the price either. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Dee Jeff
reviews.text: I called and was assisted in less than 20 minutes. Plus I was was alerted once my vehicle had arrived to the shop.

reviews.author: Angel Dodd
reviews.text: Came out on a rainy Sunday night he was very polite and professional and we will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Jamie Wall
reviews.text: Really nice guy!!y!!!! Called several companies and he was the only one willing to help me on a Saturday!!!

reviews.author: Todd Bridgeman
reviews.text: Chad is awesome and he knows what it takes when it comes to towing. I will definitely use him the next time.

reviews.author: Dana Davis
reviews.text: Great service, extremely professional and very time efficient. Really impressed and highly satisfied!

reviews.author: Lavon Nichols
reviews.text: A towing company with supposedly one worker, and absurd wait times due to having “one worker”. If I could give 0 stars I would.
